```plato

// A wide-angle camera with a fisheye radial mapping (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisheye_lens).
// FieldOfView is the full cone angle covered by the image circle; some mappings
// support a full hemisphere or more.
type FisheyeCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    Mapping: FisheyeMapping;
    FieldOfView: Angle;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}
```
